blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The National Irrigation Administration (NIA) has completed 170 solar-powered irrigation projects across Calabarzon as part of efforts to ensure a reliable and cost-efficient water supply for farmers amid the threat of prolonged dry conditions due to a “super El Niño,” according to the agency’s office in Region IV-A on Tuesday (October 13). The agency said the projects reduce its dependence on fuel-powered pumps and promote more sustainable irrigation for farming communities.
